items.name: Seredan
items.text: A local media outlet from Sereď: interviews, articles, reports and a podcast about the people, companies and life of the town.

details.summary: Seredan started as a video podcast. Today it is a local media outlet that captures life in the town: stories, successes, challenges and everyday moments.
how: We record interviews and a podcast with people, companies and personalities from Sereď.
We publish articles and reports about what is happening in the town and its surroundings.
We introduce local companies from the inside, through their people, work and stories.
We create short videos and Reels, from advertising to inspiring and fun.
benefits: One place where Sereď talks, inspires and connects.
Local companies introduce themselves through their stories and people.
Reach across the web, YouTube, Spotify, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
Entrepreneur meetups and the Documentary about Sereď under one brand.

items.title: How to build a brand that sells
items.perex: A nice video is not a brand. A brand emerges when strategy, content and results pull in the same direction.

body.h: Start with an audit, not a camera
p: Before anything is filmed, you need to know who the company sells to, what it promises and where customers' attention is lost. That is why at Buduj Značku we start with an audit and analysis, then design the strategy, and only then comes delivery and project management.
A company that skips the audit often films great content for the wrong audience.

Each video should solve one thing. An instructional video teaches one task, a recruitment video convinces one type of candidate, a short social video has to grab attention in the first seconds. The more goals, the fewer get met.
For short vertical videos (9:16), the opening shot, captions and sound decide, because many people watch without sound.

body.h: Do not just obsess over technique, focus on the story
p: One local Reel for a pizzeria passed 1,000,000 views without a big crew or expensive equipment. A good idea, a simple plot and an understanding of what the local audience actually enjoys were enough.
If a video either entertains or educates people, the algorithm rewards it with reach you cannot buy. That is why polished production should alternate with authentic social media content.

Nobody knows your company as well as you and your people do. The best content is made right on site: production, the team, real processes. That is how employer branding and instructional training videos work.
What is real is what is believable.

body.h: Measurement is part of the job
p: Quality video sells only when you know what it should deliver: enquiries, candidate applications, brand recall. Goals must be set before filming, not after.
We do not just sell nice videos. We want it to be possible to show what the videos brought the company.

items.title: What artificial intelligence can do today in a small company
items.perex: AI is no longer only for large companies. Where it helps right away, what it does not replace and how to start without risk.

p: I see the biggest benefit in everyday administration and content creation: emails, price quotes, website and social media texts, graphic drafts in tools like Canva. Even a website can be prepared today without programming.
At workshops we show how to handle these things yourself, quickly and for a fraction of the cost.
It does not replace decision-making, customer relationships or responsibility for the result. Always check the output, especially facts, numbers and the tone of communication.
AI is an assistant that speeds up work. Quality depends on what you ask of it and how you judge the result.
Pick one repetitive task that slows you down and test it with AI on real material. Compare time and quality. Only when it works, extend it to the next task.
This approach is cheap, safe and quickly shows whether it pays off.

For larger processes, such as orders, invoicing or bookings, it pays to build automation directly into the company system. At SystemX we build software so that technology takes over repetitive work and serves the company, not the other way round.

items.title: How to connect a town with local companies
items.perex: Towns and companies often talk about cooperation but lack a shared project. Film o meste is one way to create it.

body.h: A shared product instead of shared words
p: Cooperation starts to work when both sides have something to gain and something to create together. In Film o meste, that product is a documentary about the town, made with the mayor and local companies as partners.
The town receives a professional film chronicle for future generations, not a short advertisement. Local governments can receive the work free of charge, with terms agreed in person.
Partner companies gain reach through premieres and the town's channels, prestige and content for social media. They also become publicly associated with the town where they operate.
At the premiere of the pilot film in Sereď, the mayor met company directors, which is a valuable networking opportunity in itself.

First we agree with the town, then we approach local companies, and finally we film. We premiere the film and share it through the town's channels and social media. After the pilot in Sereď, films about Senec, Galanta and Šaľa are in production.

body.h: B2G: a segment that is rarely talked about
p: Most managers work in B2B or B2C. Yet B2G (Business-to-Government) is key to the development of both companies and towns. Factories, developer projects and town halls are often just metres apart, but communication between them tends to be minimal.

Developers have to settle permits and infrastructure with the town for every building. If they can show their vision and its benefit to the community before the first wall goes up, the level of discussion with the town and the public changes fundamentally.

items.title: Custom software versus off-the-shelf solutions
items.perex: A ready-made platform is a quick start. Custom software gives independence. How to decide what fits your company.

p: Platforms like Wix or Shopify can be launched quickly. The convenience comes with monthly fees, dependence on the provider and limited customisation.

The system and the data belong to you. You have your own colours, brand and domain, and you do not need third-party platforms or external apps. The software grows with the company, not the other way round.

Look at whether you have a specific process: B2B orders, bookings, invoicing with reminders or a portal for a local government. If a ready-made platform does not cover it and you work around it by hand, custom software makes sense.
At SystemX we begin with a free, non-binding consultation, then you receive a design with an exact price, and only then come development and launch with training and support.

items.title: How to build a local community of entrepreneurs
items.perex: A community does not grow from presentations. It grows from regular meetups where people advise each other and work together.

p: Podnikavci v Seredi started for three reasons: so people can get advice when they have a problem, so they find new partners to work with, and so they give each other courage. Together, it is simply easier.
We meet in a café over coffee, without stiff presentations. Entry is free and open to anyone who does business in Sereď and the surrounding area or plans to.

Each meetup has a practical topic: paid advertising and Google Business Profile, filming content with a phone, ChatGPT and AI for small companies, e-invoicing and legislation. People leave with something they can use.

Members introduce themselves and show their services. A shared video in which everyone introduced themselves in one sentence got 50,000 organic views without paid promotion. The community gained visibility too.
